title: A Border added to a picture that fills the frame shows on the picture
goal: Adding a Border to a recording or screenshot that fills the whole frame draws nothing at all: the new ring sits outside the picture's edge, which is off the canvas, so it is missing from the canvas and from the exported movie. A person adds a frame and sees nothing happen.
notes: Reproduced 2026-10-06 in border-width-keys-walk: first run added a Border to the full-frame Tutorial Sample, keyed width 0 -> 12, and every window capture showed no ring (crop of 3-second-key-at-12-sc.png at the picture's left edge: board, then picture, nothing between). Setting Position to Inside made the ring appear at once. Cause: EffectKind.border.newEffect is BorderEffect() whose position defaults to .outside (LayerEffects.swift ~554), and a layer whose frame equals the canvas has nowhere outside to draw. Likely fix: newEffect takes the layer and canvas, and lands Inside when the layer covers the canvas. The Add Effect path is shared, so check whether this needs scoping to Next.
acceptance: Open the sample recording at Next defaults, pick it, Effects + > Border: a ring is visible on the canvas without touching Position
The same ring is in an exported MP4 frame
A Border added to a shape or a title that does not fill the frame still lands Outside, as today

log.note: daily digest 2026-10-06: checked, well formed (reproduced in border-width-keys-walk, cause named). Stays p2, next in line for the loop.
